content:
A brand new stable release of Lean is now available, v4.7.0!

Highlights include:

  • A number of tactics, lemmas, and language features have been upstreamed into Lean from Std, including but not limited toomega, the library search tactics, ext, rcases, norm_cast, and solve_by_elim.
  • omega is automatically used for static checking of array lookup bounds and for termination arguments, removing the need for many manual annotations
  • Improvements in language server startup time, error messages, and completion

For a high-level summary of the release please see the announcement blog post. As usual, the finer details are available in the release notes.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.7.0.

Std, Aesop, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.7.0, as well as lean4checker and lean-repl.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.7.0
  • there is a v4.7.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

On a more personal note, this was my first time putting out a Lean release, as part of the FRO's efforts to distribute knowledge and test the documentation of our procedures. I'd like to thank @Scott Morrison in particular for their patient assistance as I worked through the process.
